source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should a lecture-notes skill keep its reusable procedure separate from one lecture's transcript?

options.text: The procedure should reproduce the same notes each time
options.feedback: Reusability means applying a method to changing inputs, not forcing every lecture to produce identical content.

options.text: The transcript must contain the skill's selection metadata
options.feedback: Selection metadata describes the skill. A transcript is source material and should not have to define the skill's identity.

options.text: The procedure must apply to different lectures
options.feedback: The skill encodes how to do recurring work; the transcript supplies the content that changes from run to run.

options.text: The transcript becomes a reusable template after one run
options.feedback: A source transcript still describes a particular lecture. Repeated use does not turn its content into a general output template.
